summary: Genmab is danish healthcare company, founded in 1998. Type: listed company. About 1,800 employees (Wikidata). Revenue DKK 14.6 billion (2022). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 2 about funding; 1 about acquisitions; 2 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: Danish antibody-medicine biotech with a site in Utrecht, about 3,000 staff worldwide; offers research, data and software internships in English.

culture.text: About 3,082 staff, headquartered in Copenhagen, with Utrecht University and Hogeschool Utrecht among top schools of its people.
Mostly biologists, pharmacists, biotechnologists and chemists, working on bispecific antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates for cancer.
Describes itself as a warm, fun, collaborative community where you can be authentically you.

open.text: All 3 current jobs here, in Utrecht (research, data and software), don't require Dutch.
International presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.

growth.text: Had about 1,800 employees in 2022 and about 3,082 now on LinkedIn.

worth_knowing.text: Its drug Epkinly, with AbbVie, cut lymphoma progression or death risk by 51% in a Phase 3 trial.
